authors: A. von Manteuffel, D. Stoeckinger, M. Weisswange
title: Four-loop renormalisation of chiral gauge theories with non-anticommuting gamma5 in the BMHV scheme
journal: JHEP 08 (2025) 088 (from search result; not verified on the arXiv page)
claim: Complete four-loop renormalization of the abelian right-handed chiral gauge theory (Tr(Y_R^3) = 0) in BMHV, the highest-order BMHV application to date. Singular counterterms: BRST-invariant part (eq. 4.14) and BRST-breaking part (eq. 4.16) with no new field monomials beyond three loops, only higher poles up to 1/eps^4. Finite restoring counterterms (eq. 4.31): only the three structures gauge bilinear, quartic gauge, fermion bilinear (choice not unique, eq. 4.32). SM fermion content mapped with numerical coefficients.
theory: abelian chiral gauge theory (SM hypercharge sector as special case)
scheme: BMHV DREG; traces factorized into D-dim and 4-dim gamma5 parts (eqs. 3.8-3.12, App. A), cyclicity kept; tadpole decomposition with auxiliary mass; no mu-terms; Feynman gauge; QGRAF/FORM, IBP (FIRE, Reduze2, Kira, Finred).
symmetry_argument: Regularized QAP with insertions; validated by four-loop vector-like QED and reproduction of three-loop chiral results.

proved: Complete four-loop counterterm action of the model (locality and Delta-insertion vs 1PI agreement checks).
checked_partially: Feynman gauge only at four loops.

red_flags: Coefficients involve Tr(Y_R^5); not analysed as a condition.
Abelian only; non-abelian BMHV known only to two loops (S3.13).
source_access: full text via arxiv.org/html (to App. B, partially)
